column2: Query1='SELECT Mnt-En-Euros.NMvt AS NMvt, Mnt-En-Euros.TYPE AS Type, Mnt-En-Euros.MoisAbs AS MoisAbs,Mnt-En-Euros.Mnt AS Mnt, Mnt-En-Euros.MONTANT AS MONTANT, MSMnt-En-Cents.TYPE AS TypeMS, MSMnt-En-Cents.MoisAbs AS MSMoisAbs, MSMnt-En-Cents.MntInt AS MntMS, MSMnt-En-Cents.MONTANT AS MONTANTMS, ( CAST( Mnt-En-Euros.MONTANT AS INTEGER ) - CAST( MSMnt-En-Cents.MntInt AS INTEGER ) ) AS delta FROM Mnt-En-Euros INNER JOIN MSMnt-En-Cents ON Mnt-En-Euros.nmvt = MSMnt-En-Cents.nmvt WHERE CAST( Mnt-En-Euros.Mnt AS reel ) <> CAST( MSMnt-En-Cents.MONTANT AS reel ) OR Mnt-En-Euros.Type <> MSMnt-En-Cents.Type OR Mnt-En-Euros.MoisAbs <> MSMnt-En-Cents.MoisAbs'
Query2='SELECT MvtReel.*, Types.*, Types.TYPE AS TType, Types.LIBELLE AS TLib FROM MvtReel LEFT OUTER JOIN Types ON Types.TYPE = MvtReel.TYPE ORDER BY NMvt ASC'
Query3='SELECT CAST( MONTANT AS REAL ) AS MntInt, CAST( AnReel AS INTEGER ) AS AnReel, CAST( MoisAbs AS INTEGER ) AS MoisAbs, CAST( MoisReel AS INTEGER ) AS Mois, mvtreelaccess.* FROM mvtreelaccess'

Query4="SELECT CAST( ( MONTANT / 100 ) AS DECIMAL ) AS Mnt, ( TType || ' - ' || TLib ) AS TypLib, CAST( AnReel AS INTEGER ) AS AnRl, CAST( MoisAbs AS INTEGER ) AS MAbs, CAST( MoisReel AS INTEGER ) AS Mois, MvtReel-Joined-W-Types.* FROM MvtReel-Joined-W-Types"
